title: References express dependencies
summary: A reference to another resource's result tells Terraform about a dependency. It can then choose a valid order of work.
introduction: A reference to another resource's result tells Terraform about a dependency. It can then choose a valid order of work. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A reference to another resource's result tells Terraform about a dependency. It can then choose a valid order of work.
The second resource depends on the first resource's output.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Draw an arrow from second to the value it needs.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: File order alone is not how Terraform decides resource dependencies.
For more detail later, use this [Terraform further reading](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials).

seo.title: Terraform: References express dependencies
seo.description: Learn about references express dependencies in Terraform. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
